method: Global four-neighbor native land corridor, square clearance at every sample, all potential gift circumcircles UNION complete unchanged axis-aligned project cores and physical entities/cliffs subtracted. Main and secondary midpoint-region witnesses minimized without changing that region; an unconstrained same-endpoint shortest alternative is diagnostic only. Full33 flat reserves are terrain support, not walls.
